:::{#thm-bernoulli-hessian-nd}
#### Negative definiteness of the Hessian of a binary sample

If $\Outvar_\iobs \simind \Ber(\prob)$ for $\iobs = 1, \dots, n$,
the [Hessian](#def-hessian) $\hess(\prob)$ of the log-likelihood is negative definite for every $\prob \in (0, 1)$,
whatever the observed outcomes. <!-- check-term-links: allow -->
Hence the log-likelihood is strictly concave on $(0, 1)$.

:::

::: proof

This is the solution to @exr-bernoulli-hessian-nd, worked in @sol-bernoulli-hessian-nd.
It builds on @thm-bernoulli-hessian-sum.

:::
